description: OpenSSL 3.4.0 rejects TLS 1.2 ClientHello with unsupported signature algorithms at the extension level, failing with 'no shared signature algorithms' error, while LibreSSL proceeds further but encounters different issues at the key exchange state.
criteria_summary: tls_version=V1_2 + first_to_fail=openssl340 + ossl_error contains 'no shared signature algorithms' + failing_input contains 'fn_fill_binder'
python_condition:
AllC(
    CheckAgentC(["protocol_config", "tls_version"], "V1_2"),
    StatusC(OSSL, in_error="no shared signature algorithms", first_to_fail=True),
    TermContainsC(OSSL, "fn_fill_binder", last_input_executed=True)
)
